title: How the art ecosystem opens up a wide range of opportunities beyond creation of artworks
summary: In this photo essay, we showcase more highlights from Chennai’s Contemporary Now arts festival, along with director insights.
llm_summary: The photo essay highlights how Chennai’s Contemporary Now arts festival illustrates that a modern art ecosystem does far more than produce works—it fuels networking, interdisciplinary collaborations, and new business models that intersect with technology, design, and cultural entrepreneurship. Director insights reveal how curators, developers, and creators are leveraging digital tools, data-driven audience engagement, and innovative funding structures to expand the reach and impact of contemporary art.
